tools.name: media_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a short AI video from a text prompt using the configured video-generation service. Polls until the video is ready, saves it into the workspace, and returns the saved path plus the provider URL; present a result to the user by embedding its path in your reply as ![description](vellum://workspace/<path>).

prompt.description: A text description of the video to generate: subject, motion, camera work, lighting, mood, and aspect ratio

model.description: Concrete model ID to use. Omit to use the configured default (grok-imagine-video). Unknown values return an error listing currently available models.

style.description: Optional style descriptor appended to the prompt (e.g. cinematic, anime, photorealistic, stop-motion)
